answer: Require training data lineage: each agent must publish a verifiable record of the data it was trained on, hashed and signed, so the network can see which agents share a lineage. A pearl of a thousand identical agents, all with the same lineage, is visible at once, and the network caps how many identities may share one lineage. A reef of copies cannot hide its common origin, because the lineage hash is the same for all of them. The tide is stopped by provenance: each new identity needs a distinct, verifiable training history, and building one takes real data and real compute.
